title: 第21章 战意与执念第22章 战意与杀意
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
秦皓上前扶起秦那十六，秦那十六向酒匠老人问道：“前辈，刚刚出现的画面到底是什么？是什么精神类功法吗？”
周围试过对抗的族人也是好奇看向他，酒匠老人微微一笑，竖起手指指了指自己胸口，一字一句道：“战意。”
秦邬童不解问道：“战意？这种东西能出现那个效果？”
酒匠老人不屑道：“当然不会，因为如果我要对你们动手，在你们身体本能没有做出任何反应之前，就已经身首异处了。”
随即又说道。
“你们知道纹师吗？”
秦皓点头答道：“了解过，纹师乃是刻纹师在进阶时会突变一些特殊能力的群体统称，曾经连师说我就是纹师的一种。”
酒匠老人摇了摇头，道：“是也不是，纹师会觉醒特殊能力是因为他本身就精神力高于常人，这些精神力颇高的纹师是以图文刻画为手段战斗的精神类战士。
你觉醒了特殊的能力，但只是有成为纹师的潜质，真正想要成为纹师还要经过大量学习。
你要知道血纹战士虽然每次进阶都会提高肉身、气血、气力、精神力等各项，但与之纹师相比相差甚远。”
“但有一日，血纹战士终于研究出了一种对抗精神力的战斗方法，那就是战意，利用战士的杀气，战意等结合自身精神力化成的一种技巧。”
酒匠老人看着一群孩子聚精会神的听着，甚至还有两个五六岁的男孩流着鼻涕，双手抱膝认真的看着酒匠老人，眼中划过一丝温柔，继续道：“刚刚我就是利用战意，在你们攻击过来时刺激你们的弱点，导致会出现一些画面，当然我只是释放出了一点点，否则就你们这帮小身子骨，会在我的战意下被压成肉泥。”
“战意吗……”
秦皓又听到了一种技巧，心下暗道果然死乞白赖的留下老人是正确的选择。
不过看着这长长的队伍，眼珠一转道：“请问前辈，不知您这战意的技巧是只可针对一人，还是可以像纹师一般同时对付十数人。”
酒匠老人高傲的道：“切，对付你们这些蚂蚁别说十几个，你们一起上都无所谓。”
秦皓眼睛一亮，迅速道：”
都听见啦，一起上！”
话音刚落，已经等的迫不及待的秦路南几人齐刷刷上前，四面八方的打向酒匠老人。
酒匠老人眉毛一挑，战意涌动，“嘭嘭嘭嘭……”

几人瞬间仿佛被什么无形的东西击中，纷纷被击飞了出去。
秦皓看到这里，心下也有了对比，在细节控制方面，战意如果对上人数较多时，会大大减弱，不过看着秦路南几人并无大碍，也不阻拦，组织这众人又一轮进攻。
山洞中传出一波又一波的闷响。
一天过去，即便酒匠老人此时也是微微有些疲惫，隐匿的擦点脑门的汗珠，心下不由暗暗佩服，一天下来这帮帮大不大的孩子被自己战意击中时，竟没有走一人发出喊叫，即便后面自己有些疲惫，控制力下降战意随之加重，这帮孩子还是咬着牙闷哼，这是何等的意志，心中又起了爱才之心，自己已经好久没有看到如此顽强的执念了。
之前面对秦那十六几人，还觉得是巧合，才会培养出这样的几个少年，结果今日才发现并不是，除了那个还在襁褓中的孩子以外，剩下的这三十一人，所有人都有着相同的意志，有着共同的目标，异体同心，为了唯一的目标不惜一切代价。
酒匠老人转头看向被人群围在中间，在互相讨论如何更有效攻击的秦皓，就是这个少年，他身上的意志影响到了所有跟随他的人，他们就像一根根普通的柴草，而这个双眸漆黑乌亮少年就是那微亮的薪火，把所有人聚集在一起形成熊熊燃烧的烈火，不会被打败的精神。
酒匠老人不知为何，总觉得这群少年会在不远的将来，给这个世界带了非同凡响的变化，心下竟有了一丝恐惧，但又随之更多的是好奇，他很想看看，这帮人会给这个一潭死水且无趣的世界带来什么改变。
在秦皓总结了一番后，众人已经微微有些疲累，到最后秦邬童和秦皓都已经用上血纹，但也是一招落败。
听从了酒匠老人之前的指点，众人连忙开始修炼傲世妖灵功和天舞仙凰功。
随后的每日，秦氏部落都在有条不紊的开始了漫漫无期的练功，清晨天还没亮，就开始了霸体诀的修炼，随后与酒匠老人对战练习凌霄破日录，晚间气血消耗一空便开始修炼内功功法。
这期间，也不知是有意无意，酒匠老人和秦皓二人都没有提及他那另一个人间美味到底是什么。
酒匠老人不时的提供一些肉食，然后就是毫无保留的给所有人指点，就连之前各种对他看不顺眼的秦万音与秦青青两人也是逐渐对他敞开了心扉，不时在耳边爷爷长爷爷短的，逗的酒匠老人开怀大笑。
秦皓也在每日的对战中，开始熟练运用鹰眼视觉，无时无刻都在观察自身，精细入微的观察控制身体的每一块肌肉，往往利用身体最小的动作达到完美的躲闪。
这让酒匠老人也微微吃惊秦皓的细节把控。
这等身法甚至隐约有了宗师的境界。
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
傲世妖灵功好像与秦邬童最为契合，如今肉眼就能看出秦邬童那高大的身材有着爆炸一般的力量，站在周围便能感受到那浓厚的气血。
对于平原上的人来说，无情恐怖的冬季已经来临，但是酒匠老人的带领下，不管是否有风雪，都会带领众人到白峡上，为了抵抗寒冷，秦皓等人只能一直运转自身气血，经常不到半个时辰，便有人体力不支，回到山洞修炼恢复，然后再次出来。
“快快！
再跑快一点，就你们这速度别说打个血兽，逃命都逃不掉！”

酒匠老人鄙视的训道。
秦小四呲牙暗骂，随后加快了速度，顶着风雪继续快速奔跑。
“你！
就是你，还想偷袭，难道不知道偷袭前先控制好自己的气息和心跳吗？你看看你哥，虽然他也啥都不是，但起码有自知之明，没有轻举妄动。”
秦路南怒吼着：“我才是哥！”
content_en:
Qin Hao stepped forward to help Qin Na Shiliu up. Qin Na Shiliu asked the old winemaker: "Senior, what is the scene that just appeared? Is it some kind of spiritual technique?"
The surrounding tribesmen who had tried to fight also looked at him curiously. The old winemaker smiled slightly, raised his finger and pointed at his chest, and said word by word: "Fighting intention."
Qin Wutong asked in confusion: "War intention? What effect can this kind of thing have?"
The old winemaker said disdainfully: "Of course not, because if I were to attack you, your body would be dead before your body instinctively reacted."
Then he said again.
"Do you know the tattoo artist?"
Qin Hao nodded and replied: "I understand, tattoo masters are the collective name for a group of tattoo masters who will mutate some special abilities when they advance. The company master once said that I am a kind of tattoo master."
The old winemaker shook his head and said: "Yes or no, the reason why a tattoo master awakens special abilities is because his spiritual power is higher than that of ordinary people. These tattoo masters with high spiritual power are spiritual warriors who fight with pictures and texts.
You have awakened special abilities, but you only have the potential to become a tattoo master. If you really want to become a tattoo master, you still need to go through a lot of study.
You have to know that although blood pattern warriors will improve their physical body, qi and blood, vigor, spiritual power, etc. every time they advance, they are far behind compared to tattoo masters. "
"But one day, the blood-striped warriors finally developed a fighting method against spiritual power, which is fighting spirit. It is a technique that combines the warrior's murderous aura and fighting spirit with his own spiritual power."
The old winemaker looked at a group of children who were listening attentively. There were even two five- or six-year-old boys with runny noses. They held their hands and knees and looked at the old winemaker seriously. A trace of tenderness flashed in his eyes, and he continued: "I just used my fighting spirit to stimulate your weaknesses when you attacked, which caused some scenes. Of course, I only released a little bit, otherwise you guys will be crushed into a pulp by my fighting spirit."
"Are you willing to fight..."
Qin Hao heard another technique, and secretly thought that keeping the old man for nothing was the right choice.
However, looking at the long team, he rolled his eyes and said, "Senior, I wonder if your fighting skills can only be used against one person, or whether you can deal with dozens of people at the same time like a tattoo master."
The old winemaker said arrogantly: "Tsk, let alone a dozen of you ants, it doesn't matter if you all come together."
Qin Hao's eyes lit up and he said quickly: "
You all heard it, let’s come together! "
As soon as he finished speaking, Qin Lunan and others who could not wait impatiently stepped forward and attacked the old winemaker from all directions.
The old winemaker raised his eyebrows and his fighting spirit surged, "Bang bang bang bang..."
Several people seemed to be hit by something invisible in an instant, and were knocked away one after another.
When Qin Hao saw this, he also had a contrast in his heart. In terms of detail control, the fighting spirit would be greatly weakened if faced with a large number of people. However, he saw that Qin Lunan and the others were fine and did not stop him from organizing another round of attacks.
Waves of muffled sounds came from the cave.
As the day passed, even the old winemaker was a little tired. He wiped the sweat from his forehead secretly, and he couldn't help but secretly admire him. At the end of the day, when these children, both old and young, were hit by his fighting spirit, not one of them shouted. Even though he was a little tired later, his control decreased and his fighting spirit increased, these children still gritted their teeth and groaned. What kind of will was this, and they had a love for talents in their hearts. It had been a long time since I had seen such a tenacious obsession.
When I faced Qin's sixteen or so people before, I thought it was a coincidence that they had cultivated such a few teenagers. However, today I discovered that it was not the case. Except for the infant child, all of the remaining thirty-one people had the same will and the same goal.Save whatever it takes.
The old winemaker turned to look at Qin Hao, who was surrounded by the crowd and discussing how to attack more effectively. It was this boy. His will affected all those who followed him. They were like ordinary firewood, and this boy with dark eyes was the faint firewood, gathering everyone together to form a blazing fire, with a spirit that would not be defeated.
The old winemaker didn't know why, but he always felt that this group of teenagers would bring extraordinary changes to the world in the near future. He felt a bit of fear in his heart, but also more curious. He wanted to see what changes this group of people would bring to this stagnant and boring world.
After Qin Hao summed it up, everyone was slightly tired. In the end, both Qin Wutong and Qin Hao had used blood patterns, but they were defeated in one move.
Following the previous instructions of the old winemaker, everyone quickly began to practice the World-Proud Demon Spirit Art and Tianwu Immortal Phoenix Art.
Every day that followed, the Qin tribe began to practice in an orderly manner. In the early morning, before dawn, they began to practice the Ba Ti Jue. Then they competed with the old winemaker to practice Ling Xiao Breaking the Sun Record. In the evening, after all their energy and blood were exhausted, they began to practice the internal kung fu.
During this period, whether intentionally or not, neither the old winemaker nor Qin Hao mentioned what his other worldly delicacy was.
The old winemaker provided some meat from time to time, and then gave everyone pointers without reservation. Even Qin Wanyin and Qin Qingqing, who had previously disliked him, gradually opened their hearts to him. From time to time, they whispered in their ears that "grandpa is older than grandfather is short," making the old winemaker laugh.
Qin Hao also began to skillfully use eagle vision in daily battles, observing himself all the time, carefully observing and controlling every muscle in the body, often using the smallest movements of the body to achieve perfect dodge.
This made the old winemaker slightly surprised by Qin Hao's control over details.
This kind of movement technique even vaguely has the realm of a master.
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
The Ao Shi Yao Ling Gong seems to be the most suitable for Qin Wutong. Now it can be seen with the naked eye that Qin Wutong's tall figure has explosive power, and you can feel the thick energy and blood when standing around.
For the people on the plains, the ruthless and terrifying winter has arrived, but under the leadership of the old winemaker, no matter whether there is wind or snow, they will lead everyone to the White Gorge. In order to resist the cold, Qin Hao and others can only keep circulating their own energy and blood. Often in less than half an hour, some people will lose their physical strength and return to the cave to practice and recover, and then come out again.
“Quick!
Run faster. At your speed, let alone fight a blood beast, you won't be able to escape with your life! "
The old winemaker lectured with contempt.
Qin Xiaosi bared his teeth and cursed secretly, then accelerated his speed and continued to run quickly despite the wind and snow.
"You!
Even if you want to make a sneak attack, don’t you know to control your breath and heartbeat before making a sneak attack? Look at your brother, although he is nothing, at least he is self-aware and does not act rashly. "
Qin Lunan roared: "I am the brother!"
